_comment: Grok harness MCP scope for Starlight Orchestrator excellence/subagent tier. Mirrors ~/.grok or xAI MCP client shape where applicable. Canonical: starlight-substrate always loaded. Excellence-specific MCPs for symmetry audit + subagent telemetry. Built on SIP — see footer.

subagent-telemetry._purpose: Track parallel subagent dispatches (up to 12), confidence scores, repo-mastery evidence, gstack QA matrices
subagent-telemetry._pattern: mcp__subagent__* tools for dispatch logging + synthesis aggregation

_task_scoped_mcps._comment: Per-session via Grok excellence orchestrator config. Examples emphasize subagent/MCP/excellence.

grok-xai-core._purpose: Native xAI Grok tool surface for subagent handoff + high context synthesis
grok-xai-core._pattern: use mcp__grok__* when available for native subagent spawn

repo-mastery._purpose: Deep pattern search + conceptual QA across adapters/harnesses/tests
repo-mastery._pattern: Grep + Glob + Read via substrate MCP + custom mastery MCP
